title: Headman
overview: Ars settles in as Canarre's headman and reflects on the status quo.

title: Canarre in Crisis
overview: The new Governor of Seitz marches on Canarre in an attempt to divide them from Couran's forces.

title: Zaht and Braham
overview: A new push by the Seitz forces puts the skills of Canarre's elite unit to the test.

title: End of Hostilities
overview: Ars asks Pham to undermine the enemy before they can mount a devastating attack.

title: The End of Vasmarque
overview: Couran and Vasmarque wage the final battle to settle control of Missian.

title: Fujimiya
overview: With a gang of bandits making trouble in Canarre, Ars happens upon a group of unusual strangers.

title: Off to Save Ars
overview: Ars's retainers gain help from an unlikely source in their mission to save him.

title: What a King Needs
overview: The attempted jailbreak reaches its climax and Rikuya has a revelation.

title: Long-Standing Feelings
overview: As new retainers begin arriving at court, Ars learns of a potential threat against his life.
